nodes.name: dispatcher.ts
nodes.summary: Core multi-agent dispatch engine for the WaggleDance package, implementing a dependency-injected `WaggleDanceDispatcher` class that routes inter-agent messages (task delegation, knowledge checks, skill sharing/requests, broadcast signals, response relay, and model recommendations) to the appropriate handler.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dependency-injection pattern via a `deps` object passed to the constructor, making all side-effectful operations (spawnWorker, searchMemory, resolveCapability, emitSignal, recordResponse, recommendModel) mockable and testable.

nodes.name: WaggleDanceDispatcher
nodes.summary: Dependency-injected dispatcher class that validates and routes WaggleDance protocol messages to one of seven typed handler methods covering the full inter-agent coordination protocol.

nodes.name: protocol.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the WaggleDance message protocol validation utilities, exporting `validateMessageTypeCombo` and `isRoutedMessage` helpers that enforce valid type/subtype combinations for inter-agent messages.

nodes.name: dispatcher.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit test suite for `WaggleDanceDispatcher`, covering all seven dispatch branches (task delegation, knowledge check, skill share/request, broadcast signal, response relay, model recommendation) using vi mock dependency injection factories.

nodes.name: integration.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for `WaggleDanceDispatcher` verifying end-to-end message dispatch flows across multiple protocol branches with realistic dependency wiring.

nodes.name: protocol.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the WaggleDance protocol validation helpers, verifying that `validateMessageTypeCombo` and `isRoutedMessage` correctly accept and reject message type combinations.
